libs.note: BH-2546. How big a merged fix round's own change may be and still have its re-review read only the delta (range-diff of the reviewed head vs the fixed head, plus the prior findings) instead of the whole branch diff, capped in lines AND bytes. Resolved by fdr_knob through lib_env_apply in a subshell, then from this file's own default in the checkout.

knobs.note: Added+deleted lines (git diff --numstat FIX_FROM HEAD) at or under which the merged re-review reads the delta only. Over it, or 0, the re-review reads the whole branch diff as before. Read by bin/lib/fix-delta-review.sh with no literal.

Byte ceiling on the delta text (git range-diff + git diff, the file $BUILD/fix-delta.diff) the merged re-review carries INLINE in its prompt. Lines are not bytes: one numstat line can be a 100KB minified file, and the prompt is one argv element to bin/agent-call.sh (AGENT_ARGV_MAX 96000, MAX_ARG_STRLEN 128KB). Over it, or 0, the re-review reads the whole branch diff as before. The max stays under AGENT_ARGV_MAX minus the prompt body. Read by bin/lib/fix-delta-review.sh with no literal.
